published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned OpenBench M4 runner invokes the native OpenCode CLI headlessly and registers first-party open-model providers through inline OpenCode configuration. The committed result rows report OpenCode 1.17.13; no canonical historical linkage is asserted here.
